target_customer: Online businesses paying card processing fees, especially subscription merchants (original idea); consumers of interactive stories (current site)
problem: Card fees and declines hurt merchants; bank payments are cheaper but awkward at checkout.
business_model: Payments fee per bank transaction (original); consumer story app (later, unverified)
product_category: Pay by bank checkout, later interactive AI storytelling

founders.name: Eleazar Vega-Gonzalez
founders.background_notes: YC page shows the name as eleazar; the full name comes from a yespress profile snippet and is not verified on a company page.

founders.name: Ryan Hall
founders.background_notes: Called co-founder and CTO by Crunchbase and a Yespress profile of Eleazar Vega-Gonzalez (https://yespress.io/eleazar); not listed on the YC page.

competitors.name: Link (pay by bank for merchants)
competitors.what: Helps merchants accept direct bank payments

competitors.name: Trustly
competitors.traction_then: Described by Link's founders as the only comparable provider

technical_complexity.rationale: Bank linking via Plaid and ACH or RTP payments need payments compliance and risk work, though built on existing rails.

defensibility.rationale: Built on Plaid and standard rails with larger funded rivals and Stripe offering similar bank payments.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Stripe and Plaid both promote pay by bank products per their own resources; coil's site later appears as an AI story placeholder.

market_need_then: Pay by bank was attracting funding in January 2023 (Link raised $30M) and card fees of 2 to 3 percent are a well known merchant pain.

branding.domain_note: Uses trycoil.com; the name collides with Coil Technologies, an unrelated web monetization company.

identity.voice_and_tone: Whimsical, ellipsis based storytelling tagline (We tell magical stories... you decide what happens)

brand_strength.rationale: Name is shared with an unrelated better known Coil and no brand coverage exists.

pivots.from: Pay by bank checkout button for merchants
pivots.why: Not stated; the pivot comes from one third party profile and the trycoil.com tagline, date not sourced

outcome_analysis: coil inc. was a one person YC W23 company that began with a Pay with coil bank payment button, then its site shows a storytelling tagline, suggesting a pivot whose timing and reason are not sourced. No funding beyond YC, customers or exit were verified. The pay by bank category was crowded with funded players, so the stage is unclear rather than a confirmed failure.
notes: The YC directory tags and one liner describe gaming, media and AI, while the YC page text describes bank payments; likely a stale description after a pivot. One database claims a coil shutdown in early 2023, likely a different company, not recorded. $500K pre-seed from aggregators is unverified. Site is a bare placeholder with a 2026 copyright. Completeness pass: the 500K pre-seed dated 2023-04 rests on Bouncewatch and VCBacked; CB Insights calls it a convertible note dated 2023-02-22 with Neer Venture Partners also listed, so date and form are uncertain.
